Platform icon file inspection per BR-TEXT-24: format sniffed from bytes; PNG via pngjs (transparent corners judged on raw alpha incl. 16-bit, edge >= 512, bounded inflate incl. interlaced); SVG via @xmldom/xmldom with step 1 faithful conversion (use expansion with x/y transforms, flattened into shapes inside clipPath; style / <style> simple selectors rewritten to the 15 presentation attributes with SVG 1.1 value grammar, colour keywords ASCII case-insensitive in canonical form; 5000 elements / depth 8 / 4x size / 2 s deadline checked while streaming) and step 2 whitelist cleaning (local #id references only), deterministic serialisation, sha256 and sanitized flag. Rejects rather than guesses. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
